newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dlr hovers near 114 yen after Sakakibara remarks.
newsitem.headline: Dlr hovers near 114 yen after Sakakibara remarks.

text.p: *Dollar hovering near 114 yen after senior MOF official Sakakibara said Japan would act decisively against excessive forex moves.
*Sakakibara was also quoted as saying that Japan trade surplus will not be major issue at upcoming G7 summit and that an imminent Japan rate rise is unlikely.
*Greenback also received a boost from comments by former MOF official that a dollar around 120 yen is appropriate, a trust bank dealer said.
